audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Trail of administrative actions with before/after and justification. 365-day retention.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: app_settings keys. Every change requires a justification and is audited.
settings.killSwitchWarning: Kill switch: affects every user immediately.

keys.commerce_enabled_desc: Turning it off blocks cart and test orders for everyone.
keys.ai_enabled_desc: Turning it off makes the engine fall back to deterministic.
keys.ai_provider_desc: openai and gemini require a server key; without one, deterministic is used.
keys.experiment_open_desc: Turning it off closes the experiment's public sign-up.
keys.retention_days_desc: Approved policy; changing it requires reviewing the privacy documentation.
keys.bootstrap_admin_emails_desc: Accounts that get the admin role on first login. Use with care.
keys.bootstrap_warning: Any e-mail in this list becomes admin on sign-up. Double-check before saving.
keys.missing: Key missing in the database (it will be created on save).

ops.title: Operations
ops.description: System routines run on demand. Results are audited.
ops.runRetentionDescription: Deletes expired analytics, anonymizes old test orders and cleans audit/runs outside the policy.
ops.advanceTransportDescription: Advances ready/in-transit fulfillments idle for longer than the given interval.
ops.transportResult: {count, plural, one {# fulfillment advanced} other {# fulfillments advanced}}

retention.title: Retention exceptions
retention.description: Scopes preserved from anonymization for legal evidence or incidents. Review is mandatory.
retention.closeDescription: The scope returns to the default retention policy.
retention.emptyDescription: Create an exception only with a documented justification.

demoAccounts.title: Demo accounts
demoAccounts.description: Creates an already confirmed account linked to an organization or personality. The password is shown only once.
demoAccounts.unavailableDescription: Without SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY on the server, accounts cannot be created. Use Invitations: the user creates the account and accepts the link.
demoAccounts.createdWarning: Write down the password now: it will not be shown or stored as text.
